name: Foliate Dish with Decoration of Double-Dragons and the Eight Buddhist Treasures
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Longqing period, 1567-1572；Enameled blue-and-white ware: molded porcelain with decoration reserved in white against an underglaze cobalt-blue ground and yellow and red enamels over reserved decoration; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading 'Da Ming Longqing nian zao' within a double circle on the base
